name: Plains prickly-poppy
desc: Annual pricklypoppy (Argemone polyanthemos): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 35 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Argemone polyanthemos, the crested pricklypoppy, also known as bluestem prickly poppy, pricklypoppy, white prickly poppy, annual pricklypoppy, or as thistle poppy is an annual plant with yellow sap…
